text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services recommends stop control for the minor street at the uncontrolled three-way intersection of McMillan Avenue and Fergalea Avenue in order to clearly define the right-of-way and to regulate traffic flow.
Scarborough Community Council: 1. Authorized compulsory stop control for northbound traffic on McMillan Avenue at Fergalea Avenue.
